memory_candidates.content: A dispatch description's own surface list for a doc-reframe task, when it says it 'was assembled by grep, not by reading,' should be treated as a lead list, not a work list: direct reading of rules/state-management.md and rules/artifact-formats.md in this corpus found zero commit-invariant assertions in either, despite both appearing in a grep-matched named-surfaces list for exactly that invariant. Verify each named surface by reading before scoping edit work to it.

In this codebase's orchestrate-state-machine.md, the stall_suspected detector is deliberately commit-gated (git log commit count over the task directory) to distinguish abandoned-wrap-up from genuine failure, while a sibling detector stranded_suspected is deliberately NOT commit-gated (heartbeat/quiescence-based) to cover the case where zero commits occurred at all. Any future change to the repository's commit posture (e.g. a class of dispatch that legitimately produces zero commits even on full success) should be checked against which of these two detectors still covers it, rather than assuming commit-gated signals are universal.

This codebase's task-reference and record-version exemption standards (task-reference-exemptions.md, record-version-exemptions.md) enforce scope via `git ls-files` enumeration, which self-excludes gitignored paths by construction -- their framing already correctly degrades under a gitignored specs/ tree without ever assuming specs/ is tracked. A rule scoped to 'every git-tracked file' rather than 'every file under specs/**' is already posture-agnostic by construction and needs no reframing when a new gitignore posture is introduced elsewhere.
